    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: While it waits the card is a dialog labelled by its title ("Coder wants to push to main") and described by the reason
      - listitem: How long is a radio group; the Allow button names the choice, e.g. "Allow for 1 hour"
      - listitem: The decided line is a status, so screen readers announce "Allowed for 1 hour" or "Denied"
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The preview rows rise in a beat after each other; the Allow label swaps softly when the scope changes
      - listitem: On a decision the card folds to one line, the check or cross pops in, and a thin bar drains until a timed grant runs out
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything switches instantly
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Fills its container up to 400px
      - listitem: Below 340px the reason loses its indent, the buttons share the width and the keyboard hints go
      - listitem: Touch screens get taller choices and buttons and no keyboard hints
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: "The component only asks – store the decision and check it where the agent acts: allow, and for scope \"timed\" also Date.now() < until"
      - listitem: Destructive actions can never be allowed for always – the choice isn't offered, even if scopes lists it
      - listitem: "Revoke, Change and Ask again all call onDecisionChange(null): treat it as \"not allowed, ask again\""
      - listitem: Keep the preview concrete (file names, addresses, amounts) – that is what makes people comfortable saying yes
      - listitem: The icons are Hugeicons Free (MIT) – keep the credit comment when you copy the file
